name: og-network-rescue
title: Network Rescue: Does Pore Concentration Ignite the Reaction Network?
concept: Reaction-network rescue: whether the spatial enrichment of og-spatial-concentration (4A) IGNITES the carbon-fixing reaction network in a pore where a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control stays dark — transport enrichment turned into network function. This is Gate B (spatial organization).
gate_reason: Network-rescue half of the former og-spatial-concentration (split from the enrichment half). Canonical arm og-30 (Gate B): at identical vent-posterior feeds a concentrating pore ignites the full network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) while a matched well-mixed control stays dead; confirmed on the six-carbon network. Supported. Carries plan_id 30 and the numeric handoff/builds_on refs to study 30. Holds Gate B's criterion_finding og30-pore-ignites-vs-control.
claim: At identical vent-posterior feeds held equal, a concentrating mineral pore ignites the carbon-fixing network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species; confirmed on the six-carbon network) while a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control stays dead — spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore causes the productive flux (og-30, canonical). Supported.
question: Does pore concentration ignite the carbon-fixing reaction network where a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control does not?
hypothesis: The enrichment a pore provides crosses the ignition threshold for the reaction network, so localization — not extra feed — is what makes the network productive.
experiment: Run the integrated pore composite at vent-posterior feeds vs a matched well-mixed nonconcentrating control (og-30), measuring net carbon flux and connectivity, and confirm on the six-carbon network.
result: The concentrating pore ignites the network (flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) while the matched well-mixed control stays dead; confirmed on the six-carbon network, within a bounded porosity window. Localization makes the network productive.

arms.concept_role: Canonical: at identical vent-posterior feeds (CO2/H2 = 1e-3) a concentrating mineral pore IGNITES the full network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) while a matched well-mixed, non-concentrating control stays dark; the C6 network og-29 found needs ~20x well-mixed feed ignites directly in the pore at base feed. Also resolves Gate A1 feed-plausibility. Benefit is a BOUNDED porosity window; network_connected is a brittle proxy near threshold.

findings.evidence_basis_note: Pore ignition at identical vent-posterior feeds vs the matched control is a model outcome.
findings.statement: At identical vent-posterior feeds (CO2/H2 = 1e-3), the concentrating pore ignites the network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4; connected; 17 persistent species) while the matched well-mixed nonconcentrating control does not (flux ~0; not connected) - spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore causes the productive flux.

The C6 network - the one og-29 found ignites only at ~20x well-mixed feed - ignites directly in the demo pore at the vent-posterior base feed (porosity 0.88, pore-local 0.023 M), net carbon flux +4.49e-4, connected, 22 persistent species, while the matched well-mixed C6 control stays dead (flux +1.5e-9, not connected). C6 shows the same bounded-window behavior as C4 - a tight pore (porosity 0.70, pore-local 2.63 M) gives higher flux (+0.072) but the connectivity metric still degrades (network_connected = 0), so there is no flux-washout upper bound; the bound above is physically-implausible feeds plus connectivity-metric degradation, not flux loss.

A porosity sweep shows the pore's benefit is a bounded window, not a broad swath. Net carbon flux rises monotonically with confinement (no flux washout in the C4 network, even at extreme feeds), but the connectivity-defined ignition (og-29's network_connected metric) occupies a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity band (~0.80-0.90; pore-local ~0.01-0.2 M) - below it enrichment is sub-threshold, and above it the pore-local feeds become physically implausible (porosity 0.70 implies 2.6 M, 0.60 implies 36 M) while the connectivity metric itself degrades, flipping 1/0/1 across adjacent porosities at similar high flux. So ignition is met in a specific pore-geometry window, not robustly across geometry.

network_connected (og-29's ignition metric) is a BRITTLE proxy near threshold - at high feed the network stays carbon-fixing (flux high and monotone in enrichment) but loses broad connectivity (connected flips to 0), the same signal og-29 recorded as "washout" at x50 well-mixed, now seen to be connectivity-breadth loss rather than flux loss, consistent across C4/C6 and well-mixed/pore. This is a methodological caveat on the ignition metric only; it does NOT touch og-29's formose refutation, which rests on the thermodynamic mechanism and the coefficient-free seed-independence discriminator, not on connectivity.

og-30 both meets Gate B's own criterion (pore flux far exceeds the matched control) and resolves Gate A's open A1 feed-plausibility question: the ~20x well-mixed ignition gap is bridged by pore enrichment within the physical pore window, so a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds inside a pore (demonstrated on C4 and confirmed directly on C6).

productive-flux-beats-wellmixed-and-nonc.detail: At the vent-posterior base feed (CO2/H2 1e-3, held equal) the concentrating pore (porosity 0.88, enrichment ~23x, pore-local ~0.023 M) ignites the network (net_carbon_flux +4.5e-4, connected, 17 persistent species) while the matched well-mixed nonconcentrating control does not (flux ~0, not connected). Confirmed on C6 (ignites in the demo pore; control dead).

colocalization-residence-measured.detail: The thermophoretic trap's co-localization (enrichment) is resolved across an empirical porosity sweep: connected-ignition occupies a bounded band (~0.80-0.90, pore-local ~0.01-0.2 M) - sub-threshold enrichment below, physically-implausible feeds + connectivity-metric degradation above. Net carbon flux is monotone in enrichment (no flux washout); a bounded window, not robust-across-geometry.

a1-feed-plausibility-resolved-in-pore.detail: The ~20x well-mixed ignition gap (og-29) is bridged at a modest physical pore (porosity 0.88), so A1's persistence firms up: a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds in a pore, within the bounded geometry window.
